_about: Redis 8.10.3 (redis:8, module bf 81001): raw replies to BF.* commands, captured for KiviDB's compatibility tests. Arguments and replies are hex.

sequences.name: transcript 1: every BF command, its errors, SCANDUMP/LOADCHUNK, RESTORE of a Redis DUMP
transcript 2: argument order and limits, sizing, BF.INSERT options
extra: check order, wrong types, missing keys, SCANDUMP/LOADCHUNK edges, bf-* settings
extra 2: LOADCHUNK headers and spans (RESP2 only)
